observations: A foam mattress lies flat on a tiled floor against a wall.
The cover has a floral pattern with repeated text or logo across the surface.
Creases and compression lines are visible along the length of the cover.
No brand plate, label, or model number is clearly readable in the photo.
The mattress appears to be a single or small double size.

claims.evidence: Photo shows wear but cannot confirm how long it has been used.
Subjective suitability cannot be confirmed from photos or seller words alone.

risks.risk: Hidden stains, bedbugs, or odors inside the foam or under the cover.
risks.proof: Close-up video of all sides, corners, and underside of the mattress.
risks.if_unproven: as a damaged or unhygienic used mattress

risks.risk: Internal foam sagging, breakage, or loss of support not visible under the cover.
risks.proof: Video of someone pressing firmly or lying on the mattress across its surface.

risks.risk: Actual size may be smaller than expected (single vs double).
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure showing length and width.

proof_requests: Video pressing down on the mattress surface across its full length
Close-up photos of all four sides and corners
Tape measure photo showing length and width
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used mattress, so it can be priced at its worst case even though the seller's age claim is unproven and hidden defects are possible.
